candidates.sentence: We need to stop the reckless spending, get inflation under control, and cut taxes so you can keep more of the money you earn for your family.
I will always fight to protect Social Security & Medicare for future generations.
I will always stand with law enforcement and ensure they have the resources to combat the fentanyl crisis and keep our community safe.
We must secure the border, build the wall, and reverse the Biden/Harris failed policies to stop the flow of illegal drugs and criminals into our communities.
